name: Peric Special Gases Co., Ltd.
summary: Peric Special Gases Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of electronic special gases and trifluoromethanesulfonic acid series products in China. The company offers nitrogen trifluoride, tungsten hexafluoride, hydrogen chloride; special electronic gases, such as deuterium, hexafluorobutadiene, octafluorocyclobutane, octafluoropropane, hexafluoroethane, and electronic mixed and pure gases; lithium bis imide, lithium and trimethylsilyl trifluoromethanesulfonate, trifluoromethanesulfonic acid, and trifluoromethanesulfonic anhydrid; and new fluorine-containing materials.
